requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation is incomplete and doesn't properly intercept and record HTTP/2 requests/responses. The hook is attempting to decorate methods but lacks proper integration with the HTTP/2 record storage mechanism.
requirement.contract: Update the hook_h2 function to properly integrate with HTTP/2 record creation and ensure that HTTP/2 requests and responses are captured with proper metadata including URL, method, status code, headers, content, and cookies. The hook should properly handle both synchronous and asynchronous HTTP/2 clients and ensure that records are added to the HTTPRecords collection.

requirement.description: The HTTP2RecordReqResp, HTTP2RecordRequest, and HTTP2RecordResponse classes have incomplete implementations for parsing HTTP/2 frames and extracting proper request/response information. The current implementation has flawed header parsing and content extraction mechanisms.
requirement.contract: Complete the HTTP2RecordReqResp class to properly parse HTTP/2 frames, extract headers from the raw data, and correctly extract content from HTTP/2 responses. Fix the HTTP2RecordRequest and HTTP2RecordResponse classes to properly extract method, URL, status code, and reason from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers (:method, :path, :authority, :status) and ensure proper cookie and header handling.

requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook does not properly handle the lifecycle of HTTP/2 connections, particularly when dealing with connection pooling and session management.
requirement.contract: Ensure that the HTTP/2 hook properly handles both individual client requests and session-based requests, properly managing the connection lifecycle and ensuring that all HTTP/2 traffic is intercepted and recorded regardless of how the client is used (individual calls vs sessions).

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class has issues with URL construction and protocol identification, causing records to be missing or incorrectly identified.
requirement.contract: Fix the URL construction in HTTP2Record to properly build complete URLs from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers, and ensure that the protocol property correctly identifies HTTP/2 traffic. Ensure that records are properly associated with the correct initiators and groups.

requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook is missing proper error handling and exception recording for HTTP/2 requests.
requirement.contract: Enhance the hook to properly catch and record exceptions that occur during HTTP/2 requests, ensuring that failed requests are properly logged in the HTTPRecords collection with appropriate error information.
